buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The payment to the outsourced staff shall be made by the agency by the 7th of

every month without any failure. In case of non-payment without any justified r eason, a penalty of Rs. 100/- per day per worker shall be recovered from the ag ency bill. 2. The payment shall be made preferably through NEFT. In case, the payment is made by Cheque or DD that should be done in the presence of the SDE / AE / JE concerned. 3. There should be no extortion of money from the outsource staff in lieu of above payment of wages or otherwise. 4. Payment should be made as per the prevalent DC rates. The difference in the DC rates at the time of allotment and at the time of payment shall be made extr a to the agency after the payment. 5. If due to any administrative reason, the bill submitted by the agency for the pre ceding month is not cleared, the agency should continue to make the payment to the outsourced staff for at least 3 months without failure. 6. The agency shall first make the payment of EPF / ESI / GST or any other statutor y dues and then the same shall be reimbursed to the agency on production of or iginal documentary proof. The original copies shall be deposited with the depar tment, however the agency can obtain the attested copies from the department . The separate ECR Challan (Contract Wise) should be filled and supplied. 7. The agency shall submit the bill to the department on monthly basis after maki ng the payment to the outsource staff and depositing the statutory payments a s mentioned above complete with documentary proof of payments and bank sta tement of workers to the complete satisfaction of SDE/AE/JE. 8. The outsource staff deputed by the agency shall report to the concerned SDE/A E/JE who shall maintain list of such staff. 9. The T&P required for safety of the staff shall be supplied by the agency. 10. The department is free to change the shifts of the outsourced staff and in case of any requirement the place of duty can also be shifted by the concerned SDE/ AE/JE. 11. The agency shall change the outsource staff, in case of any incident is raised by the concerned SDE/AE/JE. The agency cannot change any staff on his own wi thout the consent of the concerned SDE/AE/JE. 12. In case any of the outsourced staff remain absent, the agency shall provide sub

stitute for the same so that the work may not suffer. 13. In case there is any loss to the department due to negligence of the outsource staff, it is the duty of the agency to borne the same. 14. The agency / contractor should be registered with GST Department. 15. The Performance Guarantee should also be of any Nationalized Bank of Tri-city. 16. The agency will be fully responsible for adhering the labour laws and the safety and security of the outsource staff. 17. The agency should have satisfactorily completed the works as mentioned below during the last 7 years ending last day of the month previous to the submission of tender. Joint ventures are not accepted. a) Three similar works each costing not less than 40% of the tender a mount. b) Two similar works each costing not less than 60% of the tender am ount. c) One similar work costing not less than 80% of the tender amount. Note: the value of the executed works shall be brought to the current costing le vel by enhancing the actual value of the work at simple rate 7% per annum, cal culated from the date of completion to the previous day of last date of receipt of tender. 18. Average annual financial turnover on Public Health Works should be at least 30 % of the estimated cost put to tender during the immediate last three consecuti ve financial years ending 31st March 2025. The value of annual turnover figure s shall be brought to current value by enhancing the actual turnover figures at s imple rate of 7% per annum. Year in which no turnover is shown would also be considered for working out the average. Scanned copy of the certificate from C A with Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) is to be uploaded. The bi dder should not have incurred any loss (Profit after tax should be positive) in m ore than 2 years during available the last five consecutive financial year. Balan ce Sheets of financial year 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 duly certified and audited by the Chartered Accountant should be uploaded. The bal ance sheet in case of Private / Public Limited Company means its standalone fin ancial statement and consolidated financial statement both. 19. Bidders are required to submit TDS certificate in Form 16-A, in case of similar w orks are executed for a private body, which shall form basis for establishing the

completion cost of similar works executed by the bidder. 20. The bidder should furnish the AFFEDAVIT as per Annexure, duly attested by N otary Public. The affidavit of date prior to three months from the date of publishing of tender shall not be considered for qualification of Technical Bid. 21. SERVICE AND SUPPORT: The tender will be accepted only of those firms who have their office in the Tri-city i.e. Chandigarh, Panchkula and Mohali. The docu mentary evidence in this regard should be submitted. Also there should be a de dicated Telephone number for Service Support. 22. GENERIC: The bidder should not be under any liquidation, court receivership, B ankrupt or similar proceedings. Bidder should upload undertaking in this regard with bid. 23. CERTIFICATES: The bidder offer is liable to be rejected without giving any noti ce, if the required documents including certificates and Affidavit sought in the b id document or corrigendum is not uploaded. 24. As per the circular no. 1188 dated 06.05.2024 issued by the Labour Commissio ner, Chandigarh the agency shall obtain license from the Labour Department, U T, Chandigarh with in a period of 30 days of the commencement of work. 25. The agency has to produce the original documents as and when asked by the d epartment, the failure of the same will entail summarily rejection of its tender. 26. The department reserves the right to verify the particulars furnished by the app licant independently. If any information furnished by the applicant is found inco rrect at a later stage, the firm / contractor shall liable to be debarred for future t endering in Engineering Department. 27. Corrigendum / Amendment to the tender if any will be uploaded on the website. This must be noted by the Agencies / Bidders. 28. The department reserves the right to reject any or all the applicants / tenderers without assigning any reason. 29. FORMS OF EMD AND PBG : Successful bidder shall submit Performance Sec urity @ 5% of the tendered amount in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also ( besides PBG which is allowed as per GEM GTC). DD should be made in fa vor of Executive Engineer, Project Public Health Division No.3, Sector 9 payable at Chandigarh. After award of contract, successful bidder can upload scanned c opy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of the ori ginal DD to the Buyer within 15 days of the award of contract. 30. GST/Taxes as applicable to the Chandigarh Administration will be deducted fro

m the bill. 31. Ministry of Finance letter No. 29 (1) 2014 Deptt. Of Expenditure PP Division Nort h Block New Delhi dated 28.01.2014 will be part of the agreement. 32. As per letter No.19/C2/2021/PEO(GeM)/885 dated 25.10.2021, the following add itional terms and conditions are listed as under: I. Deployment of existing working / deployed resources (Manp ower):- Number of existing working / deployed resources of the procuremen t department having job satisfactory certificate, will be continued by the successful service provider under the new contract also subj ect to their consent to the terms and conditions of new contract con cluded on the basis of this bid. II. Prohibition from seeking deposits or security amount – Seeki ng any deposits or security amounts from the deployed resources or any other form of monetary acceptance by the service provider is st rictly prohibited. If any such complaint is received, incident will be r aised on GeM portal for suitable action as per incident Management Policy GeM. In addition, buyer department may separately initiate s uitable penal action as per their laid down norms. Executive Engineer, Sub Divisional Engineer, Project P.H. Division No.3, Sew-1/WS-2 / WS-6 Chandigarh. Chandigarh. SPECIMEN OF AFFEDAVIT a) That I / We hereby declare that I / We have not been black-listed / debarred / su spended by any Government / Board / Corporation / Private Firm as on last date of receipt of tender.

b) That I / We undertake to confirm that eligible similar works has/have not been executed through another contractor on back-to-back basis. Further it is undert aken that if such a violation comes to the notice of Engineering Department Cha ndigarh Administration, then I / We shall be debarred from tendering in Enginee ring Department, Chandigarh Administration in future forever and the EIC shall be free to forfeit the entire amount of Performance Guarantee deposited by me / us. c) That the deponent hereby undertakes that he / she / director(s)/partner(s) of th e proprietor / firm / company / agency have never been convicted of any crimin al offence. d) That I / We also undertake that the particulars given by me are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief and nothing has been concealed thereof . I am aware that in case of any discrepancy / false statement if found, it will le ad to rejection of my bid / tender and the Engineering Department will debar / blacklist the proprietorship / firm / company / agency as per the policy of blacklisting issued by the Chandigarh Administration vide notification dated 27. 02.2009. Dated Signature of the fir m / Agency .
